summary: A 64 dp list row: optional leading content (an Avatar, an icon), a title with an optional subtitle, optional trailing content or a built-in chevron, and an optional click.

chevron.doc: true: a muted › at the end (12 dp from the text or the trailing slot), for rows that open something

padding.doc: Start and end padding in dp. 0 inside a Card, which already pads its content, so the row lines up with the card title

onClick.doc: Makes the whole row clickable, with a ripple

leading.doc: Before the text, 16 dp from it: an Avatar, a 24 dp icon

trailing.doc: After the text: a Switch, a Badge, a value

pitfalls: Spacers, not spacedBy, separate the weighted text column from the slots: weights ignore spacedBy

Title and subtitle are one line each with an ellipsis: the text column is the weighted child, so in a narrow row it shortens with … and the slots and chevron keep their size, instead of the title wrapping out of the 64 dp row
Separate rows with a Divider whose inset is padding + 56 (lines it up with the text after a 40 dp Avatar): 72 by default, 56 with padding 0 in a Card
